messages:
marina: quick design QA — thinking through deep links for the new console IA. want to surface 'models' vs 'deployments' as first-class anchors so product teams can bookmark specific model pages
jonah: +1. do you mean separate top-level nav items or a grouped 'AI workloads' section?
marina: grouped 'AI workloads' but exposed permalinks. main ask: canonical URL for each resource and consistent breadcrumb for copy/paste
elaine: we should avoid long path nesting. current prototype uses /projects/:pid/workloads/:wid/models/:mid — that's hard to bookmark. propose: /projects/:pid/models/:mid and /projects/:pid/deploys/:did
sam: prefer shorter too. also need to decide hash vs history routing for deep links. hash keeps client-only anchors but breaks server previews. history + server fallback seems better for shareability
jonah: agree on history routing. also add a small redirect layer so old links still work: map /p/:pid/w/:wid to /projects/:pid/workloads/:wid
marina: thinking about sidebar grouping: collapsible section headers (AI Workloads) with sublinks. when collapsed, breadcrumb should still allow direct nav to children. any keyboard nav/accessibility concerns?
elaines: aria: we need aria-expanded on the group toggle, and a hidden heading for screen readers. also ensure focus ring on nav items when using arrow keys
aria-checker: automated scan flagged missing skip-link on the leftnav for keyboard users. recommended: add a top-level "Skip to content" link and ensure nav uses role="navigation"
marina: good catch. can we also support deep-link anchors to subpanels? e.g., /projects/123/models/45?tab=metrics#latency
sam: query params + hash combo is risky. prefer query param only: /.../models/45?tab=metrics and scroll-to via JS for #latency when necessary. keeps canonical URL cleaner
jonah: UX nit: breadcrumbs should use human-friendly labels not raw slugs. show project name -> Models -> {model name}. fallback to id if name missing
marina: copy tweak note: use 'Models' singular vs 'Model versions' — cross-product confusion. let's standardize on plural nouns for lists, singular for detail pages
jonah: quick dev note: route table proposal snippet:
```
{
  path: '/projects/:projectId/models',
  path: '/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId',
  path: '/projects/:projectId/deploys/:deployId'
}
```
we'll add redirect entries for legacy short links
marina: design review at 3pm to validate flows. agenda: sidebar group behavior, breadcrumb copy, deep-link share flow, a11y checklist. @jonah can you bring a prototype link?
jonah: yep. I'll drop a Figma link and a quick prototype build in #design by 2:30
marina: thanks all. sam can you add the skip-link ticket and aria fixes to eng backlog?
sam: on it. I'll include acceptance criteria + e2e keyboard test steps
turing-bot: deploy-check: no infra changes required for history routing. remember to add server rewrite rules when deploying static builds
marina: perfect. see you at 3pm :thumbsup:
